description: Wraps any value in a reactive object with `.value`. Deep by default; can be reassigned freely.
Returns a deep reactive Proxy of an object. No `.value`, but it cannot be replaced or destructured without losing reactivity.
Top-level refs are unwrapped in templates; refs nested in `reactive()` objects are unwrapped on property access; refs in reactive arrays and collections are not.
State changes queue a render that runs in the next microtask. Use `await nextTick()` to read the updated DOM.
